text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Block 100 wide, 50 tall, 24 deep, with a 140 degree V across

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its full height. The flat back goes on the rail; the V faces the pole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: V: apex 8 mm in front of the back face, 87.9 mm wide at the front face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Band groove: 14 mm tall, 1.5 mm deep, across the whole back face,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred on the height. The band runs in it, between saddle and rail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print standing on the 100 x 24 end, so the V profile is on the bed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two M5 heat-set inserts, 6.8 mm holes 10 deep in the back face,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 14 mm each side of centre and 16 mm above the middle (lower saddle)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: or below it (upper saddle): print one, turn the other over.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two M5 x 16 countersunk screws from the front of the rail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 140 mm pole touches the V faces 24 mm each side of centre; a 200 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pole 34 mm; an 80 mm pole 14 mm. Never on the V's edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on a pole or tube it must not rock.
